description: Complete A4 (V-2) ballistic rocket, assembled largely from original components with some reproduction parts (notably the air rudders) and displayed impaled through the museum's glass wedge. A separate original A4 combustion chamber recovered from the Mittelwerk tunnels is also exhibited.

Original Soyuz 29 descent capsule in which Sigmund Jaehn, the first German in space, returned to Earth in 1978. Back at the museum after several years on loan to the Deutsches Museum in Munich; suspended several storeys up in the wedge.
American MGR-1 Honest John unguided short-range battlefield rocket, shown in the hail of bombs and rockets installation.
French AS.30 solid-fuel air-to-surface missile in the missile showcase.
73 mm Propagandagranate 41, a small spin-stabilised solid-fuel rocket used to scatter leaflets over enemy positions.
